listings.name: Chevening Scholarships
listings.deadline_note: Annual UK Government scholarship for eligible international Master's applicants including Nigeria
listings.criteria_text: Chevening supports emerging leaders from around the world to pursue a one-year Master's degree in the UK. Applicants must demonstrate leadership potential, a strong academic background, and a clear vision for creating positive change in their home country.
listings.essay_prompt: Explain how your proposed Master's study will enable you to make a meaningful contribution to your home country upon graduation.

listings.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
listings.deadline_note: Commonwealth scholarships for talented individuals from eligible Commonwealth countries
listings.criteria_text: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships enable talented individuals to gain knowledge and skills required for sustainable development. Candidates are selected based on academic merit, study plan quality, and development impact in their home country.
listings.essay_prompt: Outline how your research and education will address sustainable development challenges in your home country.

listings.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
listings.deadline_note: Full tuition, living stipend, roundtrip airfare, and health insurance for graduate study in the United States.
listings.criteria_text: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program enables graduate students, young professionals and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States. Operates in more than 160 countries worldwide.
listings.essay_prompt: Provide a clear and detailed description of the study or research you wish to pursue in the United States, including your future professional goals.

listings.name: Rhodes Scholarship for West Africa
listings.deadline_note: Oldest international scholarship in the world, covering Oxford University course fees and stipend.
listings.criteria_text: The Rhodes Scholarship is a fully funded, full-time postgraduate award for talented young leaders to study at Oxford University. Candidates must demonstrate academic excellence, character, leadership instincts, and commitment to service.
listings.essay_prompt: Write a personal statement explaining your general interests and activities, what you propose to do at Oxford, and your vision for public service.

listings.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
listings.provider: Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation / University of Cambridge
listings.deadline_note: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
listings.criteria_text: Gates Cambridge seeks intellectually outstanding individuals with leadership capacity and a strong commitment to improving the lives of others across the world.
listings.essay_prompt: Describe how your academic background and leadership ambitions align with the Gates Cambridge mission of making a positive social impact.

listings.name: PTDF Overseas Scholarship Scheme
listings.deadline_note: Federal Government of Nigeria flagship scholarship for study in the UK, Germany, France, and Malaysia.
listings.criteria_text: PTDF awards overseas scholarships to Nigerian graduates with exceptional academic performance in engineering and computing disciplines relevant to national energy and technological development.
listings.essay_prompt: State your proposed study plan and explain how it will contribute to technological advancement and national development in Nigeria.

listings.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
listings.deadline_note: Comprehensive full scholarship covering tuition, housing, books, health insurance, and leadership programming.
listings.criteria_text: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program provides comprehensive support to academically talented young leaders from Africa facing significant financial barriers.
listings.essay_prompt: Describe a significant challenge you have overcome and how you plan to give back to your community in Africa upon completion of your studies.

listings.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarships
listings.deadline_note: Fully funded joint master's programs across multiple European universities with monthly living allowance.
listings.criteria_text: Erasmus Mundus high-level integrated master programmes are delivered by international consortiums of higher education institutions in Europe.
listings.essay_prompt: Explain your academic motivation for joining this European joint degree and how mobility across institutions will benefit your career.

listings.name: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP)
listings.deadline_note: Covers tuition fees, monthly living allowance of SEK 12,000, travel grant, and health insurance.
listings.criteria_text: The SI Scholarship aims to develop global leaders who contribute to the United Nations 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
listings.essay_prompt: Describe your work experience and how your proposed master's programme in Sweden aligns with your career goals and sustainable development priorities.

listings.name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
listings.deadline_note: Full scholarship with EUR 934 monthly allowance, health insurance, and travel stipend in Germany.
listings.criteria_text: DAAD EPOS supports young professionals from developing countries to pursue postgraduate study at German universities in development-relevant disciplines.
listings.essay_prompt: Outline your personal, academic and professional reasons for applying to this specific German postgraduate programme.

listings.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
listings.deadline_note: $50,000 CAD per year for three years during doctoral studies at Canadian universities.
listings.criteria_text: The Vanier CGS program aims to attract and retain world-class doctoral students by supporting students who demonstrate both leadership skills and a high standard of scholarly achievement.
listings.essay_prompt: Describe your personal leadership style, community engagement, and how your proposed doctoral research will yield significant global impact.

listings.name: Turkiye Burslari Government Scholarships
listings.provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities
listings.deadline_note: Full government scholarship covering university placement, tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, and flights.
listings.criteria_text: Turkiye Burslari is a government-funded, competitive higher education scholarship program awarded to outstanding international students and researchers.
listings.essay_prompt: Explain your academic motivation, preferred field of study in Turkey, and how you intend to foster bilateral development after graduation.

listings.name: Aurora Energy AI Scholarship
listings.criteria_text: The Aurora Energy AI Scholarship supports graduates who want to apply machine learning to energy systems. The committee looks for strong technical grades, hands on projects, community impact and leadership.
listings.essay_prompt: In 300 words, describe how your work will benefit your community.

listings.name: Northlight Graduate Award
listings.criteria_text: The Northlight Graduate Award supports research on technology that improves public services. The committee looks for teamwork, curiosity, research potential and engagement with public policy.
listings.essay_prompt: In 250 words, explain how you would use technology to address a public problem.

listings.name: Harbor Bay Foundation Award
listings.criteria_text: The Harbor Bay Award funds Master's study in artificial intelligence and related engineering fields. The foundation looks for curiosity, volunteering and resilience.
listings.essay_prompt: In 200 words, tell us about a time you taught or helped others.
